_comment: AgentVault schema, hand-authored 2026-09-01 based on real content review (not the generate_schema.py baseline, which collapsed everything into one generic type and mangled Windows folder paths -- see bus/log.md-adjacent session notes / ARCHITECTURE.md section on autograph for why).

hub.description: Entry-point/index file that orients a reader into a section (Master Agent Index, the Unverified Logs readme)

guideline.description: Shared cross-agent process, convention, or pattern documentation

team-spec.description: Specification for one agent's role, capabilities, and responsibilities

task-protocol.description: Documentation for an active, in-use task-dispatch or testing protocol

blueprint.description: Architecture/design blueprint for a specific external project

research-note.description: Auto-generated, unverified research note from the background research crew -- raw web-search extracts, needs human review before being trusted

path_type_hints._comment: folder substring -> type name (used when card has no type field)

status_order._comment: sort order for MOC generation (lower = higher priority / needs-attention-first)

status_defaults._comment: default status for new cards by type (when status is missing)

richness_fields._comment: frontmatter fields that indicate content richness (used by dedup) -- kept from the script baseline, these are genuinely the real fields the research-crew notes already carry

entity_extraction._comment: settings for daily.py entity extraction -- not used by this vault today (no daily/ folder), kept as a harmless default

decay._comment_domain_rates: research notes are raw/unreviewed and most likely to go stale fast; team specs and guidelines are foundational and should decay slowly
